gap: Grandpa fishing shirts are almost all pun typography ('reel', 'fishing is my game') or cartoon fish. None found is a painted scene. Ours is a full watercolor lake at sunrise (dock, tackle box, rod and bobber, leaping trout, rowboat, cattails, mountains) with a nostalgic phrase instead of a pun, which suits grandpa gifting and our watercolor style.
